rationale: Base 90c4b639. AD-338 and epic #880 task D3. Two new internal modules join facts-codec in contracts/ir.json: archkeel.ir.reference_context holds the memoized reference check, archkeel.ir.validated_facts holds the proof that the decoder validated one object. The public entry archkeel.ir.facts_validation:validate_source_facts of ir is replaced by archkeel.ir.validated_facts:ensure_valid_source_facts in both contract files, because evaluate_source was its only user outside ir. No budget, rule, component or requires entry changes. The baseline stays the same.
